The structure of MgSi is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with a cell formula Mg4Si4 and 8 atoms per unit cell across 2 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows both Mg and Si centers with 14 geometric neighbors each, over a neighbor distance range of about 2.54–3.19 Å; this is a single connected 3D periodic component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 14-vertex Mg and Si coordination polyhedra, with additional corner- and edge-sharing among Mg polyhedra.
